description: One-paragraph description of the business, what it sells, and who it helps. This is the core instruction the AI uses to judge relevance and write comments.
target_audience: Who the ideal person to engage with is (e.g. small e-commerce owners evaluating fulfillment tools).
comment_tone: Helpful, peer-to-peer, never salesy. Sound like a knowledgeable person in the community, not a brand. No links unless directly asked.
avoid: do not pitch the product directly
